core_obligations: Combine the two approximating cartesian diagrams into a common refinement of their bases of finite type over Z.

Descend both properties to the single approximation.

difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes and two properties of morphisms stable under base change, if each property is realised by some finite type approximation of the morphism over a base of finite type over Z, then both properties are realised by a single such approximation. The proof combines the two approximating diagrams by forming a common refinement of their bases and descending both properties to it, using base-change stability to keep the properties when the base is enlarged. Producing one approximation carrying both properties is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10036-10072.
